paper_metadata.title: Ti-Fe-Sn-Nb hypoeutectic alloys with superb yield strength and significant strain-hardening

evidence.quote: In this letter new Ti-Fe-Sn-Nb hypoeutectic alloy comprised of primary dendritic β-Ti and ultrafine (β-Ti + TiFe) eutectic was developed showing superior mechanical properties.
